purpose: Engineering and compute feasibility pilot, not a converged policy or final research comparison
action: 11 active channels: arm 7, gripper 1, torso 1, base 2; stationary head expanded as two zeros
observation: Native HAB state + previous/current returned force /100, cumulative contact /5000, elapsed fraction; state SAC uses identical input
training_budget_rule: Complete pilot, measure wall time and memory; no extrapolation from PushCube throughput
risk_stage_gate: Do not train or claim a risk-aware planner until a task-solving world-model baseline and matched-observation SAC are established. Pilot alone is not a research benchmark.
